original.prompt: In January 2026, bank unions gave notice of a nationwide strike to demand a five-day work week. Consider the following statements:
items: The United Forum of Bank Unions is a coalition of nine bank staff unions.
The Indian Banks' Association negotiates on behalf of banks in wage settlements.
Since 2015, all Saturdays have been holidays for banks in India.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 3 is wrong. In 2015 banks moved to the 2nd and 4th Saturdays off, and the unions are still seeking all Saturdays off. They say the IBA agreed to this in a March 2024 wage settlement, but government sign-off is pending.
original.source: In 2015, banks shifted to 2nd and 4th Saturdays off.
